description: This file defines the ByteArray class, which extends SplFixedArray to provide byte array operations such as encoding, comparison, XOR, incrementing, bit-shifting, selection, setting, slicing, zeroizing, and serialization. It is part of the AWS SDK for PHP cryptography component.

classes.name: ByteArray
classes.description: A class representing a byte array with cryptographic utilities, including encoding, comparison, XOR, increment, and other byte manipulations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a ByteArray from an integer, string, array, or another ByteArray, handling various input types and initializing the internal array accordingly.

methods.name: enc32be
methods.description: Encodes a 32-bit unsigned integer into a ByteArray in big-endian order.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Compares this ByteArray with another for equality.

methods.name: exclusiveOr
methods.description: Performs a bitwise XOR with another ByteArray of the same size, returning a new ByteArray.

methods.name: getIncremented
methods.description: Returns a new ByteArray incremented by a specified amount, handling carry-over in big-endian order.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to ensure that values are masked to a byte (0-255).

methods.name: rshift
methods.description: Returns a new ByteArray shifted right by one bit.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Constant-time select between two ByteArrays based on a select mask (1 or 0).

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a portion of the ByteArray using another ByteArray, starting at a specified offset.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Returns a slice of the ByteArray as a new ByteArray.

methods.name: zeroize
methods.description: Resets all values in the ByteArray to zero.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the ByteArray as a binary string.
